magnetics.winding: 3-ph double layer 24 slots, 10/12 pitch, 2 parallel paths, Litz (0.2 mm strands), class H, vacuum-pressure impregnated

cooling.rotor: filtered intake air drawn through the gap by the compressor-eye suction (~0.5 % of the air, ~3 kPa), magnets ~130-150 C (est); Sm2Co17 good to 300 C

rotor_mech.build: Sm2Co17 segments (2 halves x 8 axial pieces), bonded on the d80 rotor body; T700/T800 carbon sleeve wound with pre-tension (or pressed on a 1:200 taper); 1.4404 end rings = balance planes; balance G1 as an assembly

rectifier.type: 6-pulse diode bridge (or 12-pulse with a 2 x 3-ph winding)
rectifier.window: 400 V-class AFE: DC >= ~620 V at full load, no-load <= 850 V (braking chopper clamps load rejection)

conversion.dc_bus_V: 620-850 (load dependent; AFE holds it, braking chopper at 860 V)

grid.type: IGBT active front end supply unit + LCL filter, 400 V 50 Hz, ~350 kVA
grid.candidates: ABB ACS880-207 IGBT supply unit (FI/CH), Danfoss VACON NXA AFE (FI/DK), Siemens SINAMICS S120 Active Line Module (DE), Ingeteam (ES), Inovance / INVT (CN)

start.type: standard inverter module on the DC bus (<= 500 Hz output), 45 kW class, contactor to the PMG
start.energy: from the grid through the AFE (black start: 50 kWh battery on the DC bus, optional)

conversion.why: no frequency changer >= 600 Hz (dual-use 3A225); every block is a standard industrial product; the diode bridge blocks by itself while motoring

buy_options: active parts (stator with winding + magnet rotor sleeve) made to this spec by a high-speed machine shop: e+a Elektromaschinen und Antriebe (CH)
complete HS machine: Safran GENeUS 300 (FR; 300 kW, 550-800 VDC with integrated active rectifier, ~40k rpm) - inquire 24/7 industrial rating, export
turbo-blower HS motor makers as a cross-check / supplier of the stator stack (KEBA LeviTurb 300 AT; Chinese maglev-blower motor makers - inquiry)
